readme_hash:
3922:# Quietline

Encrypted on-chain mail on Starknet.

Addresses never appear on the message. Content decrypts only on the
recipient's device. A private transfer can carry a memo in the same
transaction —
summary: Encrypt and send messages on Starknet using private transactions.
description_long: The project enables users to send encrypted messages on Starknet, ensuring that sender and recipient identities remain hidden. It uses a 'privacy_invoke' helper to handle encryption, and messages can optionally include payment memos within the same private transaction. The challenge tackled is ensuring that no server holds plaintext data, thereby enhancing the privacy of communication.
latest_push: Added encrypted mail inbox UI and crypto primitives for Quietline.

name: Erebus
readme_hash:
9436:# Erebus

**Negotiate in darkness, settle in silence.**

Erebus is experimental coordination and shielded-settlement infrastructure for AI agents.

[Open the public demo](https://erebus-private-agents
summary: Provide infrastructure for autonomous AI agent negotiations and settlements.
description_long: The project enables AI agents to negotiate and settle transactions securely through encrypted channels, ensuring that the negotiation process remains private. It aims to solve the issue of transparency in agent-to-agent commerce by providing atomic settlements and controlled disclosure of transaction details, preventing unauthorized observers from gleaning insights from metadata alone.
latest_push: Added sprint demo and fixed license and documentation issues.
